areas.name: boulder-creek
areas.label: Boulder Creek, CA
areas.description: Real land cover (OpenStreetMap) and elevation (AWS Terrain Tiles) around 37.126, -122.122. Land without an OSM land-cover polygon is assumed to be conifer forest (redwoods). OSM fetched in overpass-turbo on 2026-10-31.

areas.name: crozier
areas.label: Crozier Fire 2024, CA (real-fire test)
areas.description: Real pre-fire fuel (LANDFIRE 2023, Scott & Burgan 40 fuel models) and elevation (AWS Terrain Tiles) around the 2024 Crozier Fire, El Dorado County. Simulated with the Rothermel spread model.
